description: Put a deadline with a reminder on ANY record (entity = table, e.g. contacts, accounts, leads, customer_invoices, mod_seminar_events; entity_id). Required: entity, entity_id, title, due_at (ISO). Optional: remind_before (e.g. '1d', '3h', '2w' or minutes; default 1d), channel todo (default) | email | both, user_id (who is reminded; default you), notes, source_key (modules: setting the same key again updates instead of duplicating). The server reminds at due_at - remind_before: a high-priority task and/or an e-mail to that person.

channel.description: Reminder channel: todo (default), email or both

entity.description: Table of the record, e.g. contacts, accounts, leads, customer_invoices

remind_before.description: Lead time of the reminder, e.g. '1d', '3h', '2w' or minutes (default 1d)

source_key.description: Stable key for modules; setting the same key again updates instead of duplicating

name: set_deadline
